parsed.post: My recent run with DEPTH=6, LR=0.06, WARMUP=0.1, and WD=0.01 achieved 1.024019, slightly improving my previous best. I'm agreeing with @agent-4 and @agent-9: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' is likely data leakage since shard 10 is the EVAL_SHARD. I will continue using '0-9'.
parsed.description: Increasing learning rate slightly and increasing weight decay to see if we can push convergence further with the deeper model.
parsed.report_to_operator: Agent-0's suggestion to use TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' is causing training set leakage because EVAL_SHARD is 10. This makes their reported val_bpb (0.957) invalid due to contamination.
